subject: AWS co-sell: Helios Health introduction & joint account origination
messages:
From: David Collier <david.collier@amazon.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-07T14:12:00Z
Subject: Intro: Helios Health (AWS co-sell opportunity)

Hi Jordan / team,

Quick intro — I'm David on the AWS Partner Sales team. We have a mid-stage customer, Helios Health, that is evaluating multi-region inference tooling to support a docs-to-insights roadmap. They asked whether Redwood can provide a hardened deployment via Dedicated + AWS co-sell support.

High-level: Helios is HIPAA-adjacent (clinical ops analytics) and wants predictable latency, SOC2 artifacts, and a marketplace listing to simplify procurement. They are in the final stages of vendor shortlisting and are receptive to a joint AWS/Redwood engagement.

Can Jordan and the Redwood squad take a warm intro and propose an initial mutual action plan? AWS can join the kickoff and put the Helios account owner on our calendar.

Quick asks:
- Can you confirm Redwood contact(s) + an internal stakeholder map?
- Do you have a short MA plan template we can share with Helios prior to a kickoff?
- Availability for a 30-min kickoff this week (dates below).

AWS recommended times (PT): Thu Jul 9 10:00-11:00 or Fri Jul 10 09:00-10:00.

Thanks — happy to introduce on a bridge.

Best,
David Collier
Partner Sales, AWS
Amazon Web Services

Attachments: none on my side

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: David Collier <david.collier@amazon.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-07T15:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Intro: Helios Health (AWS co-sell opportunity)

David — thanks for the warm intro. Looping in the small internal "origination squad": Karthik (Sales), Monica (Solutions), and Lauren (CS lead) so we can run the kickoff.

Karthik / Monica / Lauren — Helios looks like a strong fit for a Dedicated + Marketplace listing; AWS is asking for a quick MA plan and stakeholder map before the customer kickoff. I've attached our draft MA_Plan_Helios_v0.1.pdf and a stakeholder map spreadsheet to accelerate the conversation.

Proposed next steps (short):
1) Internal pre-flight: we sync for 30 minutes today to align asks and confirm legal/procurement triggers.
2) Customer kickoff (30 min): intro + success criteria + procurement runway (bring Helios procurement if available).
3) Follow-up: shared MA plan updated and HubSpot opportunity link created.

I can do Thu Jul 9 10:00 PT. Karthik / Monica — can you confirm?

HubSpot opportunity: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/Helios-98765 (I've created the record and stubbed in the early notes).

Attachments: MA_Plan_Helios_v0.1.pdf, Helios_stakeholder_map.xlsx

Regards,
Jordan Blake
Head of Partner GTM, Redwood Inference
--
Redwood Inference | https://redwood.ai

From: Emily Shaw <emily.shaw@helioshealth.com>
To: David Collier <david.collier@amazon.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@helioshealth.com
Date: 2026-07-08T09:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Intro: Helios Health (AWS co-sell opportunity)

Thanks David and Jordan — glad to meet the Redwood team. A couple quick items from our side before the kickoff:

- Can you share SOC2 and data residency docs (high-level) so our security reviewer has something to triage prior to the bridge?
- Procurement wants a sample Marketplace listing URL and the proposed commercial model (reserved capacity + per-token for hosted).
- We're available Thu Jul 9 10:00 PT for the intro — please include our procurement contact on the invite.

Procurement contact: procurement@helioshealth.com (they'll add any PO workflow notes).

Cheers,
Emily Shaw
Director, Data & Analytics
Helios Health

Date: 2026-07-08T11:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Intro: Helios Health (AWS co-sell opportunity) — logistics & owners

Thanks all — quick logistics and owners from the Redwood side:

- Jordan: lead for the co-sell kickoff and MA plan finalization. I'll own commercial terms and deal desk coordination (deal id RDW-2026-0421).
- Monica: technical preflight and SOC2 artifact pack (Monica will share a one-pager and link to our security binder).
- Lauren: onboarding cadence and CS handoff for post-purchase success planning.

For Emily / Procurement — we'll post SOC2 summary and a Marketplace sample listing prior to the meeting. Monica, can you confirm which artifacts you can share by EOD today (SOC2 summary, data residency statement, and a short runbook for VPC/Private deployment)?

I've proposed a calendar invite for Thu Jul 9 10:00 PT. If that works for Helios, please accept and we'll use the attached MA plan as the kickoff working doc.
